payload.name: Extract illustrative personal events with resolved dates
payload.description: When processing a message for memory construction, if the speaker states a personal event or activity as an example, aside, or illustration, use this Skill to capture it as a distinct fact and resolve any relative time expression from the message timestamp.
content: Treat every directly stated speaker event as a separate extraction candidate, even when the message's main purpose is encouragement, advice, or opinion.
Resolve relative time expressions (e.g., 'last Friday', 'yesterday', 'this morning') using the message/session timestamp and set the event's start time accordingly.
Do not fold a distinct personal event into a memory that only summarizes the speaker's attitude or ongoing support; keep the event available as its own queryable memory.

solves: Construction extraction often summarizes a message's dominant conversational intent (e.g., encouragement or advice) and drops a directly stated personal event that the speaker mentions as an example or aside. Future questions can target that dropped event, so no memory supports it. This Skill instructs extractors to preserve every directly stated speaker event as its own fact and to resolve relative time expressions from the message/session timestamp, making such events queryable across equivalent future conversations.
